settings.text: Orders will be processed every day from Monday to Saturday, delivery time is 2-5 days. If it is a pre-order, please wait for 10-15 days for the package to arrive.
FREE SHIPPING for all the address in Thailand (Multiple items, additional shipping fees will apply.)

- Within 5 days from the date of successful delivery.
- Applicable for exchange when the product has a manufacturing defect, shipping error or is exchanged at the customer's request (change color, change size, change model).
- For significantly worn or washed items, there is no entitlement to a refund or exchange.
